theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cone_of_wedge_vanishing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), 0 < n → R.Represents C → BoundaryVanishes C → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft β x) = 0) → IsConeCurrent C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
